title: Robichaud's band, Tranchina's and Up a Lazy River
summary: They discuss the left-handed fiddler Robichaud and who wrote Up a Lazy River.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose

blocks.x: And, and they had a good band, a, a fiddle player, what's his name, Ro, Robichaud or something like that?
Well, Robichaud was a left-handed fiddle player.
He's the guy that used to play in the Lyric Theater in New Orleans.

And he's the guy who wrote, uh, Up a Lazy River. Really? He's the guy, he never wrote Up a Lazy River, but Sidney Ayrton wrote Up a Lazy River. Mm-hmm. And he used to, uh, with the same changes as, uh, I wish I could shimmy like my sister Kate. Mm-hmm. That's the one that, uh, the Robichaud wrote.
And they used the same changes, only, used the clarinet chorus that Sidney Ayrton used to play. And, uh, and, uh, what's her name, wrote the lyrics, uh, I can't think of that.
You mean, wrote the lyrics to Lazy Rebel?
